description: Add a task to the reader's list. `text` may say things in plain words: a due date (tomorrow, friday, Dec 3), a time (3pm), an estimate (~20m), priority (! to !!!), a project (#home), where it goes (@today, @later, @waiting) or a repeat (every monday). Fields given separately win.

text.description: The task, e.g. "Call the dentist tomorrow 3pm ~15m".

waitingOn.description: Who or what it waits on (with state waiting).

name: add_task
title: Add a task
